r.t: Sukuna, known as the "King of Curses," possesses an extraordinary level of intelligence and understanding in the realm of jujutsu. His intellect spans various aspects of cursed techniques, curses, binding vows, cursed tools, and reverse cursed techniques. Here are the key facets of Sukuna's intellect that make him a formidable opponent:

: Sukuna holds a vast amount of knowledge of the jujutsu world, from the location of the Black Box for Cursed Techniques in the brain to various curses, cursed tools, Binding Vows, and reverse cursed techniques. He possessed this knowledge long before it became common in the modern age. This extensive knowledge allows Sukuna to quickly understand and counteract techniques and strategies that others may struggle with, giving him a significant advantage in any encounter.

: His knowledge is only rivaled by Gojo, a natural genius, and surpassed by Kenjaku, the smartest character in the verse. Sukuna's understanding of jujutsu is unparalleled except for these two. This positions Sukuna as a top-tier intellect in the jujutsu world, capable of devising and implementing complex strategies.

: Sukuna saw the potential in Megumi Fushiguro's technique and kept Megumi in mind for future use. Once he obtained Megumi's body, Sukuna completed the subjugation ritual to tame Mahoraga, intrigued by its ability to adapt to any phenomenon. This demonstrates Sukuna's long-term strategic planning and ability to exploit the strengths of others for his own gain.

: Sukuna devised plans to manipulate and control situations to his advantage, such as tearing out his own heart to force a Binding Vow on Yuji. Additionally, after taking over Megumi's body, Sukuna bathed in cursed energy (evil energy) and killed Megumi's sister to plunge Megumi's soul further into despair, ensuring that Megumi wouldn't fight to regain control of his body. This level of manipulation showcases his willingness to use extreme measures to achieve his goals, illustrating his ruthless and calculated nature.

: Having existed since the Golden Age of Jujutsu, Sukuna fully grasps cursed techniques, and both cursed and reverse cursed energy. This historical perspective gives him a deep understanding of the evolution and nuances of jujutsu, allowing him to anticipate and counter modern techniques effectively.

: He understands the importance of not pushing beyond one's limits and explains the intricacies of binding vows to Yuji. This demonstrates his practical knowledge and ability to teach and manipulate others, reinforcing his dominance in the jujutsu world.

: Sukuna quickly deduces the workings of cursed techniques after seeing them once or twice and creates suitable counters. His experience allows him to identify most cursed techniques effortlessly. This quick deduction capability means he can adapt to new threats in real-time, maintaining his edge over opponents.

: He noticed the uniqueness of Megumi's shikigami abilities, deducing its origin from shadows and identifying the Blade of Extermination's positive energy before understanding Mahoraga's adaptive ability and defeating it. This showcases his detailed analytical skills and ability to understand and counter rare and complex techniques.

: Sukuna takes every fight seriously, deeply analyzing and being constantly aware of his opponent's abilities. During his first battle with Gojo, he began deducing Gojo's innate technique and adapted accordingly. This highlights his ability to remain composed and strategic even when faced with powerful adversaries.

: Sukuna observed Mahoraga's adaptation during their fight and used this understanding to calibrate his own Cursed Technique to counter Gojo's Limitless. This demonstrated his ability to innovate and adapt quickly in combat. This adaptability is crucial in high-stakes battles, allowing him to turn the tide in his favor.

: Sukuna's ability to analyze and counter complex techniques, such as Mahoraga's adaptive ability and Gojo's Infinity, showcases his combat genius. His deep analytical skills enable him to identify weaknesses and exploit them effectively.

Sukuna can cast a Domain Expansion at a speed comparable to Gojo, despite requiring more complex hand signs. His ability to switch between Domain Amplification and Cursed Techniques in battle is a testament to his superior cursed energy control. This versatility makes him a formidable opponent who can adapt his fighting style on the fly.

Sukuna holds the title of the "strongest sorcerer in history," having defeated many high-ranking clans during the Heian Era. He is acknowledged by Satoru Gojo, the "strongest sorcerer of the modern era." This recognition cements his status as a top-tier combatant whose skills are respected and feared.

Sukuna's Domain Expansion operates with an open barrier, a feat compared to "painting without a canvas." This divine-level technique alters reality itself and is stronger than Kenjaku's domain. This demonstrates his unparalleled mastery over domain techniques, making his attacks more unpredictable and devastating.

Sukuna developed the ability to speed up his cursed technique burnout from Kenjaku's soul splitting, applying it to his Reverse Cursed Technique after experiencing it once. This innovation showcases his ability to learn and adapt techniques from others, enhancing his own capabilities.

: Sukuna strategically used Mahoraga to bypass Gojo's Infinity, showing his tactical adaptability. This ability to leverage the strengths of others to overcome seemingly insurmountable obstacles is a testament to his strategic genius.

: His ability to switch between Domain Amplification and innate techniques is a testament to his strategic depth. This versatility allows him to adapt his tactics to the situation, maintaining the upper hand in battle.

: Sukuna grasped the potential of Megumi's cursed technique and formed a binding vow to seize his body. This demonstrates his ability to recognize and exploit the potential in others, using it to further his own goals.

: He manipulated Hana Kurusu's memories to gain control and cause critical injury. This feat showcases his psychological manipulation skills, allowing him to turn allies into enemies and create opportunities for attack.

: Sukuna created a technique to bypass Gojo's Infinity by adapting Mahoraga's model, a feat he achieved in one try. This innovation highlights his ability to solve complex problems quickly and effectively.

: He copied the concept of soul splitting and refreshed his cursed technique burnout after seeing Gojo do it once. This ability to learn and apply new techniques after a single observation demonstrates his exceptional learning and adaptive abilities.
: Sukuna's Open Barrier Domain is the strongest, requiring the user to alter space itself, a divine-level feat. This mastery over domain techniques places him at the pinnacle of jujutsu sorcery.
